text:
Laura P: Quick heads-up — AetherRack is trying to add transit-insurance to our reserved rack shipment and bump the lead time. They quoted 2% of invoice + 48h hold. ETA moved to 'early May'. This will tighten our onboarding window. @Omar L @Priya S any quick takes?

Omar L: Ack. Can we carve a split delivery? Ask them to release racks into a bonded warehouse on arrival and we pay for inland only. That would avoid the 48h carrier-imposed hold.

Priya S: From GTM side we promised customers 90% of allocated capacity by 2026-05-15. If we miss that we're in trouble. If insurance is only 2% (2% of $200k = $4k) maybe pay it, but need finance signoff. @Mike O can you run a quick cost vs SLA hit?

Mike O: On it. If invoice ~200k, insurance ~$4k, but holding/detention fees could be higher. Two options: (1) pay insurance & ask partner for credit on next PO; (2) escalate to vendor ops and request a 'no-delay' SLA w/penalty. Option 1 is fastest. Assigning me to model numbers.

supply-bot: AETHER_RACK_MANIFEST update: container C-03 -> Estimated departure +48h (carrier delay). ETA to port now 2026-05-03. :grimacing:

Omar L: If carrier delay holds, bonded split doesn't help immediately. Can we ask them to swap to expedited trucking off-port to meet 5/15? What's the cost delta?

Mike O: I'll run numbers. Quick ask @Laura P — what's our acceptable unit shortfall before we trigger customer communications?

Laura P: We can tolerate up to 8% shortfall but anything >8% needs CS + product to notify. Also open to paying insurance if it prevents delay. Who owns negotiation with AetherRack commercial?

Priya S: I'll lead the commercial ask — will push for credit + waive the transit hold. Also checking if SI partner NodeIntegrate needs advanced notice for rack arrival and install slots.

Laura P: Cool. Next steps: @Priya S reach out to AetherRack commercial now; @Mike O share quick cost calc in #finance-review; @Omar L check if bonded warehouse slot available w/our broker. I'll update partner roadmap and draft customer communication if we hit >8%. Thanks.

Mike O: I'll post calc in 10m.
